assay: bulk total RNA-seq (Ribo-Zero), mouse gastrocnemius, HiSeq 2500 PE100
primary_estimand: Effect of one 1-h treadmill exercise bout versus sham exercise (stationary treadmill) on gastrocnemius gene expression, separately for exercise in the early rest phase (ZT3) and the early active phase (ZT15), at 0, 4, 8, 12, 16 and 20 h after exercise; and whether the exercise effect differs between the two times of day
inclusion: Male C57BL/6J, 10-11 weeks; n=5-6 per phase x treatment x time cell; one mouse per sample (terminal harvest)
planned_contrasts: Exercise vs sedentary within the rest phase at each of 6 post-exercise times (abstract; GEO overall design)
Exercise vs sedentary within the active phase at each of 6 post-exercise times (abstract; GEO overall design)
Time-of-day dependence of the exercise response (abstract: 'distinct responses ... in either the early rest phase or the early active phase')
paper_method: edgeR on featureCounts counts after filtering to CPM > 2 in >= 34 samples (GEO data_processing); circadian/oscillation analysis also used (abstract: 'metabolic oscillations'), method not stated in the abstract
paper_results: Abstract: glycolytic activation specific to active-phase exercise; HIF1a selectively activated in a time-dependent manner; no DEG counts and no named genes other than HIF1a in the abstract
